findings:
🟠 [group-broadcast-gate] MUST-FIX `send_to_peer` accepts `to:"@group"` with ordinary content when `fleet_wide:true`—the added test explicitly sends `"hello lab"` successfully—so the required BROADCAST content gate is bypassed; apply the existing `@team` content-prefix gate to `@group` and update the test to require/reject the corresponding content.
🟠 [stream-group-retention] MUST-FIX the stream parser never copies `raw.group` onto the parsed envelope and only deletes it when absent; downstream casts show `group` is outside the baseline `Envelope` surface, so schema parsing can strip a relay-supplied group and prevent claude-channel metadata from receiving it; validate and preserve the raw group after parsing, with a stream-level regression test.
🟠 [configured-default-unused] MUST-FIX `cfg.default_group` is validated and displayed but never applied to outbound `@group` messages, while `ask_group` also emits no group, causing the relay’s own default rather than the configured membership to receive broadcasts; use the resolved strict runtime default when an `@group` send omits `group`, including permission-relay sends.
